question: Hello Odacchi. Boss Jinbe's joining is cool. I have a question about the words "please allow me to introduce myself!" in Chapter 976. I heard this phrase in the lyrics of the song てなもんや三度笠 (Tenamonya Sandogasa) when I was listening to the best period drama CD. Did you take it from there~!?
answer: Hmm~ You didn't write your age but your interest is very old~ Just like me when I was younger. (laughs) This phrase you can heard in historical dramas and chivalry movies, To be honest, as well as lines that begin with "Hikeenasutte!!". Roughly speaking, it is his greeting from the old yakuza. It's like introducing yourself "Oh, listen to me! My name is ○○, I was born in ○○...". This is called "cutting morality".
name: Petan
